ns0:svg.ns0:title: Cold-process time of seven exact Kloosterman methods at 25 field-degree and rank pairs
ns0:svg.ns0:desc: Five panels fix L at 4, 6, 8, 12, and 16. N is 4, 6, 8, 12, and 16. Logarithmic time axes show medians and observed minimum–maximum ranges of three fresh processes. Each process includes initialization and four exact queries. The adjacent CSV contains all 175 coordinates. AH and Bessel measurements and the baseline measurements come from different execution batches.
